name: Kleintierpraxis Preetz / Schellhorn – Dr. Gesine Krefft
clinician_review: Dr. med. vet. Gesine Krefft, current veterinarian and practice owner; specialist in anatomy, histology and embryology. Oncology is a continuing-education interest, not an oncology board credential. Anna Hebestreit also listed as veterinarian.
availability_note: Owned services explicitly list oncology and cancer therapy. Specific chemotherapy delivery and tumor surgery are not separately established. Appointment consultations by telephone; Wednesday afternoons closed.
